9pool_speed.summary: Pool at 9, gas, ling speed. Standard ZvZ opener: lings ~1:55, speed ~3:30. Beats 12 hatch, trades evenly with overpool.
9pool_speed.risk: 12 pool muta timing if lings do nothing

overpool.summary: Overlord at 9, pool, hatch after. Balanced: lings ~2:15 with better economy than 9 pool.
overpool.risk: 9 pool speed if lings are not kept home

12pool.summary: Pool at 12 after overlord, gas, lair. Economic ZvZ into fast mutalisk.

12hatch_11pool.summary: Hatch first. Greedy in ZvZ: only vs a scouted slow pool or when the enemy drone-scouts late.
12hatch_11pool.risk: 9 pool and anything faster loses the hatch

2hatch_muta.summary: Mid-game transition: 2 hatch, lair, spire, mutalisk + scourge. The standard ZvZ mid game.

3hatch_muta.summary: Mid-game transition: 3 hatch before spire. Only when the enemy is slower to spire or lings are contained.

3hatch_hydra.summary: Mid-game transition: hydra den for anti-muta. Rare in ZvZ; vs mass muta with spores.

lurker_contain.summary: Lurker timing vs a ling-heavy enemy with no spire. Rare.

reference_timings.extractor: 9 pool speed 1:15-1:30; 12 pool 1:50; no gas by 2:30 = ling flood or hatch-first economy
reference_timings.hydralisk_den: unusual in ZvZ: hydra vs muta
